scope: Deferred normalization of unused Anime-Sama episode players only; Sources FR runtime unchanged

benchmark.scope: Synthetic HTTP only, actual native JS wrappers; local processing and request counts, no network/device speed guarantee

live.scope: Dedicated plugin with literal native JS wrappers and Python HTTP; no physical device test

limitations: Synthetic CPU/request benchmark, not physical Android or total remote loading speed.
Live probes use explicit native metadata controls, not the private configured AIOmetadata endpoint. Preview AIO paths are covered by offline literal-wrapper regressions.
Live upstream HTTP failures are retained; stable One Piece Mobile has a timed-out caption probe; all returned media samples were reachable. No host was dropped or blacklisted to make coverage pass.
Each live sample executes all six installed entry IDs and verifies the combined partition.
